reason: Freeze dose-family multiplicity, realized-dose reporting, clustered sensitivity, and quality sensitivity before any new-dose embedding or BDD result is read.

primary_overall_dose_family.minimum_detectable_nominal_dose_rule: Smallest nonzero dose with realized-kinematic gate PASS and overall paired-BDD Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.

realized_kinematic_gate.pass_rule: One-sided log-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound must be > 0 for both required metrics at the dose.

nominal_vs_realized_dose_reporting.nominal_axis: linear interpolation fraction in six longitudinal IDM parameters
nominal_vs_realized_dose_reporting.required_statement: A nominal parameter dose is not assumed to produce a linear behavioral dose.
nominal_vs_realized_dose_reporting.minimum_detectable_realized_effect: Report realized kinematic estimates and cluster intervals associated with the minimum detectable nominal dose; do not generalize them as universal thresholds.

paired_bdd_primary.bandwidth: pooled positive off-diagonal exact median independently fixed per frozen dose comparison

log_cluster_sensitivity.randomization: flip the A/B labels for all scenario pairs sharing the same log_name as one cluster

lane_quality_sensitivity.prohibition: Do not filter, reweight, or replace the frozen paired primary using realized lane quality.

dose_zero_role: descriptive origin only; no inferential p-value and no duplicated same-sample claim
